description:
Aggregate the work that removes repeated work from validation capture, issue creation, `validate --fix` and link checking, and measures the result.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Capture specs validate only added entries, and a capture applies its base requests once.
- [hard] REQ-02: Issue creation reports findings from its own mutation image, identically in human and JSON output.
- [hard] REQ-03: `validate --fix` publishes one mutation and always reports one post-fix report.
- [hard] REQ-04: Link checking probes each distinct URL once through one timed agent with bounded concurrency.
- [hard] REQ-05: A recorded release-build run on this repository shows per-issue validation no slower than whole validation.
title: Capture, creation, fix and link checking stop repeating work
